en: The postcard features a monochrome reproduction of an old master portrait painting, showing an older woman dressed in dark clothing and a distinctive head covering common in 17th-century northern Europe. The portrait is rendered in a classic, painterly style, reminiscent of artists like Rembrandt. The card has a blank area at the bottom, often used for captions or correspondence, but there is no visible handwritten or printed text.
